bullets.text: Russia reports that a Ukrainian drone attack on a busy Black Sea resort killed seven people, including three children, and injured 40 others.
Analysts warn that the threat to oil tankers in the Middle East is at its worst since the start of the Iran war, due to fresh attacks on alternative shipping routes.

European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has called for stronger EU borders and action in five areas of migration control following the Ceuta crisis, which saw tens of thousands cross from Morocco into the Spanish enclave.
The leader of a prominent US Jewish organisation has warned Australia faces a critical test in addressing the rise of antisemitism.
The Queensland government wrote off nearly $140 million in fines last financial year, almost doubling the amount from two years prior.
Hundreds of people protested a One Nation fundraiser in Hawthorn East, Melbourne, which was attended by Pauline Hanson.

Japan's Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama has confirmed the country's readiness for further yen intervention, including joint action with the US, to counter 'disorderly movements' in the currency market.
Williams Companies has agreed to acquire Momentum Midstream LLC for up to $5.5 billion, expanding its natural gas network along the US Gulf Coast.
AstraZeneca investors have expressed concerns over potential mega-merger talks with Bristol Myers Squibb, citing looming patent cliffs and antitrust risks in a possible $400 billion tie-up.
